coder_notes: The authors augmented NEU-DET to 2750 images ('PRO-DataSet', Table 1) without reporting any train/val/test split ratio. In Table 2 (ablation study), only Precision (93.49% -> 96.96%, +3.47 pp) and Recall (91.02% -> 93.73%) are tabulated for baseline YOLOv10n vs LAM-YOLOv10n; in Table 3 (comparative experiment), Map@0.5 is reported for LAM-YOLOv10n (94.39%) and 8 other detectors (highest baseline in Table 3 is RT-DETR at 93.08%, YOLOv8n is 89.35%, YOLOv5s is 84.27%), while YOLOv10n's Map@0.5 is only plotted in Figures 7c and 8 without an exact numerical value in text or tables.
